arguments.sql: SELECT c.name AS Kunde, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS Betrag FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE c.country = 'FR' AND YEAR(o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.name
